title: Разрешаем и помогаем решиться
description: Разрешаем и помогаем решиться: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Использовать encourage someone to do без потери адресата
notes: Allow + человек + to-infinitive: They allowed us to leave.
Encourage someone to try означает поддержать человека в попытке, а не гарантировать результат.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: The tutor encouraged the beginners ___ questions.
exercises.explanation: Encouraged + адресат + to ask — правильная модель.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: to / for.

public_payload.sentence: The library allows students ___ borrow laptops.

exercises.editorial_answer: The library allows students to borrow laptops.
exercises.explanation: После allows students требуется to borrow.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Нам разрешили пользоваться меньшей комнатой.»
exercises.editorial_answer: They allowed us to use the smaller room.
exercises.explanation: Us обозначает получателей разрешения, to use — разрешённое действие.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: The coach encouraged me try again.

accepted: The coach encouraged me to try again.

exercises.reference_answer: The coach encouraged me to try again.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The coach encouraged me try again.
exercises.editorial_answer: The coach encouraged me to try again.
exercises.explanation: После encouraged me нужен инфинитив с to.

public_payload.passage: The club allowed beginners to borrow equipment for their first session. The tutor encouraged everyone to try a simple task before buying anything. One student found the activity harder than expected and decided to attend another introductory session. The tutor supported that choice rather than promising immediate success. Permission to borrow equipment reduced the cost of trying, but it did not remove the need to practise.

options.label: So every student would have to buy immediately.
So they could try the activity before buying equipment.

exercises.editorial_answer: So they could try the activity before buying equipment.
exercises.explanation: Разрешение снижает стоимость первой попытки, не гарантируя результат.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: allow — разрешать; encourage — поощрять, поддерживать; attempt — попытка; permission — разрешение
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: allow — разрешать; encourage — поощрять, поддерживать; attempt — попытка; permission — разрешение.

exercises.prompt: Как преподаватель отнёсся к повторному вводному занятию?

public_payload.passage: The club allowed beginners to borrow equipment for their first session. The tutor encouraged everyone to try a simple task before buying anything. One student found the activity harder than expected and decided to attend another introductory session. The tutor supported that choice rather than promising immediate success. Permission to borrow equipment reduced the cost of trying, but it did not remove the need to practise.

options.label: Promised that all tasks were already mastered.

exercises.explanation: Поддержка выбора не превращается в обещание мгновенного успеха.

exercises.prompt: Сообщи о разрешении с адресатом us.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Can we use the studio after class?

options.label: The organiser has allowed us staying until six.
The organiser has allowed to us stay until six.
The organiser has allowed us to stay until six.

exercises.editorial_answer: The organiser has allowed us to stay until six.
exercises.explanation: Allowed us to stay сохраняет объект и правильный инфинитив.

public_payload.sentence: To support someone in making an effort is to ___ them.

exercises.explanation: Encourage — поддерживать или поощрять, без обязательной гарантии результата.
